identity: RW Vehicles Tempo. The kill is a small number of artifact threats the pool's removal is badly shaped to answer, funded by a repeatable enter-the-battlefield engine. Golden Argosy attacks as a 3/6 and 'exile[s] each creature that crewed it this turn. Return them to the battlefield tapped' - so the crew must be REAL cards with re-triggerable ETBs, never tokens, because an exiled token ceases to exist. Argivian Cavalier, Resolute Reinforcements and Automatic Librarian are that crew: each pays crew 1 by itself and re-fires its ETB every attack, minting a Soldier or a scry 2 per turn for free. Samite Herbalist is the fourth crew slot and works on a different axis - 'Whenever this creature becomes tapped, you gain 1 life and scry 1' triggers on CREWING, so it pays off both Vehicles and every attack without needing the 1-of Argosy at all. Weatherlight Compleated is a {2} 5/5 flier that Astor's 'Vehicles you control have crew 1' switches on - it prints no crew ability of its own - and while uncrewed and below four phyresis counters it is not a creature, so the cube's sorcery-speed removal cannot touch it. Serra Paragon rebuys the crew fuel from the graveyard. Danitha, Benalia's Hope closes, arriving pre-equipped off her own ETB.

mainboard.name: Vanquisher's Axe
mainboard.oracle_text:
Equipped creature gets +2/+0.
Equip {2} ({2}: Attach to target creature you control. Equip only as a sorcery.)
mainboard.role: Engine/Infrastructure - +2/+0 for {1}; Danitha's ETB target and Astor's equip-{1} payoff

mainboard.name: Hero's Heirloom
mainboard.role: Engine/Infrastructure - +2/+1. CORRECTED per Challenger F7: the legendary trample/haste rider is live on 4 LEGENDARY PERMANENTS, not 2 - Astor and Danitha are legendary creatures, and Golden Argosy and Weatherlight Compleated are both 'Legendary Artifact - Vehicle', which are legal Equipment targets once crewed. Hero's Heirloom on a crewed Golden Argosy is a 5/7 with trample, on a body whose entire job is connecting to fire its attack trigger; on a crewed Weatherlight Compleated it is a 7/6 flying trample. The pre-repair record said '4 of the 8 creature cards' and 'Astor and Danitha only' in the same sentence, and the correct creature-card denominator is 7, not 8.

mainboard.name: Weatherlight Compleated
mainboard.oracle_text:
Flying
As long as Weatherlight Compleated has four or more phyresis counters on it, it's a Phyrexian creature in addition to its other types.
Whenever a creature you control dies, put a phyresis counter on Weatherlight Compleated. Then draw a card if it has seven or more phyresis counters on it. If it doesn't, scry 1.
mainboard.role: Payload/Payoff - {2} 5/5 flier switched on by Astor's granted crew 1. Uncrewed AND below four phyresis counters it is not a creature and cannot be targeted by creature removal - a PHASE, not a permanent state: the fourth counter flips it into a creature permanently and turns removal back on.

mainboard.oracle_text:
Flash (You may cast this spell any time you could cast an instant.)
When this creature enters, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token.
mainboard.role: Enabler - crew fuel #2; flash, and one card is two bodies per ETB

mainboard.name: Lightning Strike
mainboard.oracle_text: Lightning Strike deals 3 damage to any target.
mainboard.role: Interaction - 3 damage to any target; also reach

mainboard.name: Destroy Evil
mainboard.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Destroy target creature with toughness 4 or greater.
• Destroy target enchantment.
mainboard.role: Interaction - enchantment removal or kills a toughness-4-or-greater creature; the only mainboard enchantment answer

mainboard.name: Take Up the Shield
mainboard.oracle_text: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. It gains lifelink and indestructible until end of turn. (Damage and effects that say "destroy" don't destroy it.)
mainboard.role: Interaction/Protection - MAINDECKED in Phase 9 as the fix for the disruption-fizzle finding. 'It gains lifelink and indestructible until end of turn' is the real answer to a removal spell cast in response to the Argosy attack trigger, and it is live against the 9 'destroy target' effects in the 271-card pool.

mainboard.name: Samite Herbalist
mainboard.oracle_text: Whenever this creature becomes tapped, you gain 1 life and scry 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put that card on the bottom.)
mainboard.role: Enabler - crew fuel #4, on a different axis from the other three. 'Whenever this creature becomes tapped, you gain 1 life and scry 1' triggers on CREWING and on attacking, so unlike an ETB-based fuel card it pays off both Vehicles and needs no Argosy at all. Added in Phase 9 on the Challenger's absence finding.

mainboard.name: Argivian Cavalier
mainboard.oracle_text:
Enlist (As this creature attacks, you may tap a nonattacking creature you control without summoning sickness. When you do, add its power to this creature's until end of turn.)
When this creature enters, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token.
mainboard.role: Enabler - crew fuel #1; pays crew 1 alone and remakes a 1/1 Soldier on every Argosy return. Its enlist is DEAD in the crewing line (a creature that crewed and was exiled is not an attacker) and no enlist role is claimed anywhere.

mainboard.name: Automatic Librarian
mainboard.oracle_text: When this creature enters, scry 2. (Look at the top two cards of your library, then put any number of them on the bottom and the rest on top in any order.)
mainboard.role: Enabler - crew fuel #3; a colourless 3/2 whose 'scry 2' re-fires every Argosy attack. Selection, not card advantage.

mainboard.name: Citizen's Arrest
mainboard.oracle_text: When this enchantment enters, exile target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.
mainboard.role: Interaction - unconditional exile of any creature or planeswalker; also the best Serra Paragon rebuy in the list at MV 3

mainboard.name: Hurloon Battle Hymn
mainboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {W} (You may pay an additional {W} as you cast this spell.)
Hurloon Battle Hymn deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If this spell was kicked, you gain 4 life.
mainboard.role: Interaction - 4 damage to a creature/planeswalker; kicked {W} gains 4 life

mainboard.name: Astor, Bearer of Blades
mainboard.oracle_text:
When Astor enters, look at the top seven cards of your library. You may reveal an Equipment or Vehicle card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
Equipment you control have equip {1}.
Vehicles you control have crew 1.
mainboard.role: Engine - grants Weatherlight the crew ability it does not print, reduces equip to {1}, and digs 7 for the package (6 physical targets). The deck's only red permanent.

mainboard.name: Golden Argosy
mainboard.oracle_text:
Whenever Golden Argosy attacks, exile each creature that crewed it this turn. Return them to the battlefield tapped under their owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
Crew 1 (Tap any number of creatures you control with total power 1 or more: This Vehicle becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.)
mainboard.role: Payload/Payoff + Engine - 3/6 attacker whose attack trigger re-fires the ETB of whatever crewed it, every turn. NEVER crew it with a token: 'exile each creature that crewed it this turn' removes a token permanently. Crewable at instant speed, so it also blocks as a 3/6.

mainboard.name: Serra Paragon
mainboard.oracle_text:
Flying
Once during each of your turns, you may play a land from your graveyard or cast a permanent spell with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard. If you do, it gains "When this permanent is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, exile it and you gain 2 life."
mainboard.role: Payload/Payoff + Engine - 3/4 flier; 'cast a permanent spell with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard' once per turn. This is ONE cast per turn at full mana cost, restricted to MV<=3 permanents and lands - NOT a second draw step. Legal targets: 8 of the 15 distinct nonland cards (Vanquisher's Axe, Hero's Heirloom, Weatherlight Compleated, Resolute Reinforcements, Take Up the Shield is an instant so NO - corrected list: Vanquisher's Axe, Hero's Heirloom, Weatherlight Compleated, Resolute Reinforcements, Samite Herbalist, Argivian Cavalier, Automatic Librarian, Citizen's Arrest) plus all 17 lands.

mainboard.oracle_text:

When Danitha enters, you may put an Aura or Equipment card from your hand or graveyard onto the battlefield attached to Danitha.
mainboard.role: Payload/Payoff - 4/4 first strike / vigilance / lifelink that arrives already carrying an Equipment from hand OR graveyard (4 Equipment copies in the list)

La victoria es un número pequeño de amenazas de artefacto a las que la eliminación del pool está mal preparada para responder, financiadas por un motor repetible de entradas al campo de batalla. Golden Argosy ataca como un 3/6 y 'exile[s] each creature that crewed it this turn. Return them to the battlefield tapped', así que la tripulación deben ser cartas REALES con entradas redisparables, nunca fichas, porque una ficha exiliada deja de existir. Argivian Cavalier, Resolute Reinforcements y Automatic Librarian son esa tripulación: cada una paga tripular 1 por sí sola y vuelve a disparar su entrada en cada ataque, acuñando un Soldado o un scry 2 por turno gratis. Samite Herbalist es el cuarto hueco de tripulación y funciona en otro eje: 'Whenever this creature becomes tapped, you gain 1 life and scry 1' se dispara al TRIPULAR, así que paga tanto con los Vehículos como con cada ataque sin necesitar la Argosy de copia única. Weatherlight Compleated es un volador 5/5 por {2} que el 'Vehicles you control have crew 1' de Astor activa — no imprime habilidad de tripular propia — y mientras no esté tripulada y por debajo de cuatro contadores de phyresis no es una criatura, así que la eliminación a velocidad de conjuro del cubo no puede tocarla. Serra Paragon recompra el combustible de tripulación desde el cementerio. Danitha, Benalia's Hope cierra, llegando ya equipada gracias a su propia entrada.
